DEN_BackupLeader
Cerys is an Asmodeus tiefling scout travelling with a group of tiefling refugees. She can be found during certain events in Act One if some specific characters are dead, or more usually at Last Light Inn during Act Two.
“
We've lost people today. But we are alive, and the dead have bought us a chance.
„
— Cerys, after the loss of their leaders.

Involvement

Act One

Cerys does not typically appear until Act Two. However she serves as a failsafe in Act One in the event both  Zevlor and  Asharak have died, with the game requiring a tiefling leader to trigger certain events such as ⁠Raid the Grove, or the camp party after once ⁠Defeat the Goblins has been completed.

Successfully defending the Emerald Grove from  Minthara's raid results in Cerys running in from outside, calling for either Zevlor or Asharak, before forcing dialogue with the party. The party can tell Cerys of the previous leaders' fates, to which she reacts with dismay.[1] If the goblins' leaders are killed, Cerys instead waits with the rest of the tieflings at the grove's entrance, telling the party that she noticed them clearing the Goblin Camp, but found Zevlor dead back in the grove as well. In both cases, she immediately takes charge of the remaining tiefling survivors, and rewards the party for their deeds.

Act Two

If the tiefling refugees are rescued and en route to Baldur's Gate, Cerys moves to the Last Light Inn with the remaining tiefling survivors. Talking with her reveals that Zevlor had betrayed them[2] by surrendering the refugees to the Absolute, and that she and a few others managed to flee to Last Light Inn while the rest were either killed or captured. She asks the party to help the tieflings who were captured and taken to Moonrise Towers.

It is also revealed there that Cerys was the scout responsible for finding their road to Baldur's Gate, although the road had turned out to be one that led directly into the Shadow-Cursed Lands, and by extension, the Cult of the Absolute's main base of power in Moonrise Towers.

Upon rescuing the tieflings from Moonrise, Cerys thanks the party. After Moonrise Towers is cleared and  Ketheric Thorm defeated, Cerys moves behind Moonrise Towers' throne room, scavenging supplies and preparing for the remainder of the road ahead. She can be told about Zevlor's fate if he was encountered and saved from the Mind Flayer Colony, to which she reacts with anger. Alternatively, she can be told that Zevlor died (even if he was rescued), to which she reacts with remorseful upset.

Act Three

Cerys moves to the refugee camp in Rivington with the remaining tiefling refugees. She can be told about Zevlor's fate if he was encountered in the Mind Flayer Colony if this was not already done in Act Two.
